d:
A beautiful melody that captures the magic of love and destiny! Bol Meri Taqdeer Mein Kya Hai from the classic film Hariyali Aur Rasta (1962) features the charming pairing of Mala Sinha and Manoj Kumar. Soulfully sung by Lata Mangeshkar and Mukesh, this evergreen romantic duet remains one of the memorable musical gems of Hindi cinema.
Bol Meri Taqdeer Mein Kya Hai | Hariyali Aur Rasta | Lata-Mukesh | Manoj Kumar & Mala Sinha Special
Song: Bol Meri Taqdeer Mein Kya Hai (Part 1)
Movie: Hariyali Aur Rasta (1962)
Star Cast: Mala Sinha, Manoj Kumar
Singers: Lata Mangeshkar, Mukesh
